title: Equivalent Fractions on the Number Line
objective: Recognize and show that equivalent fractions refer to the same point on the number line.

problems.text: Use the fractional units on the left to count up on the number line. Label the missing fractions on the blanks.
Use the number lines above to: Color fractions equal to 1 half blue. Color fractions equal to 1 yellow. Color fractions equal to 3 halves green. Color fractions equal to 2 red.
Use the number lines above to make the number sentences true.

Jack and Jill use rain gauges the same size and shape to measure rain on the top of a hill. Jack's gauge is marked in fourths of an inch. Jill's gauge measures in eighths of an inch. On Thursday, Jack's gauge measured 2/4 inches of rain. They both had the same amount of water, so what was the reading on Jill's gauge?
